## Five Core Engineering Pillars (`qilaidav.com` <-> `github.com/qilaidev`)

1. **01 · Full-Stack Technical SEO & GEO Diagnostics (`https://qilaidav.com/seo/` | EN: `https://qilaidav.com/en/seo/`)**
   - Live HTTP chain & redirect tracing, Cloudflare edge cache verification, headless browser DOM rendering, tag-stripped visible character counting, CJK/ASCII SERP 62/160-unit pixel budget enforcement, Schema.org `@id` entity graph auditing, and GEO readiness (`llms.txt`, `codemeta.json`).
   - Open-Source Architecture & Profile Index: `https://github.com/qilaidev/qilaidev`

2. **02 · Cross-Platform Smart Ad Ops & Compliance Penetration (`https://qilaidav.com/ads/` | EN: `https://qilaidav.com/en/ads/`)**
   - Ad review policy pre-flight checks across X (Twitter), Facebook, Telegram Ads, and Google Ads; 1:1 outer ad copy to inner landing page / Bot first-screen DOM alignment; 5-minute dayparting budget control; historical social asset compliance cleanup.
   - Open-Source Evidence Repositories:
     - `https://github.com/qilaidev/social-cleaner` — Cross-platform social account hygiene & compliance pre-flight CLI (`--dry-run` preview, JSON/CSV backups, append-only `audit.jsonl`, Playwright/API execution).
     - `https://github.com/qilaidev/social-copilot` — Local-first AI social reply Chrome & Edge MV3 extension with BYOK adapters and tone presets.

3. **03 · Telegram Channel Ops (OASH) & Human-Grade Persona Engine (`https://qilaidav.com/oash/` | EN: `https://qilaidav.com/en/oash/`)**
   - OASH multi-source ingestion, 6-dimension compliance filtering, tone rewriting, and staggered scheduling; Human-grade Persona Engine with 24-hour circadian rhythm curves, reading/typing byte delays (`200 ms`), dual-track group/DM memory, and seamless sales handoff.
   - Open-Source Evidence Repositories:
     - `https://github.com/qilaidev/social-copilot` — Cross-app messaging reply assistant (Telegram Web, WhatsApp Web, Slack Web) with custom persona prompts.
     - `https://github.com/qilaidev/wechat-localmind` & `https://github.com/qilaidev/whatsapp-localmind` — Read-only group-chat context extraction & MCP Stdio servers.
     - `https://github.com/qilaidev/social-cleaner` — Historical post/reply hygiene and append-only audit logging.

4. **04 · Mobile Automation Matrix & Edge Anti-Detect Infrastructure (`https://qilaidav.com/cloud-matrix/` | EN: `https://qilaidav.com/en/cloud-matrix/`)**
   - 6-layer decoupled mobile & edge architecture: ROM-level deterministic hardware fingerprint locking across reboots (L1-L2), 1-device-1-residential-IP alignment (L3), Android Accessibility node tree + Visual OCR dual-mode state machines (L4-L5), and circuit-breaker self-healing (L6).
   - Open-Source Evidence Repository:
     - `https://github.com/qilaidev/anyreality-resi-stack` — Multi-path self-hosted sing-box deployment stack (VLESS+REALITY+Vision, Hysteria2, WS+CDN, dual-node routing, 10-stage `--with-warp`, adaptive tri-format subscription, `redact.sh` secret hygiene).

5. **05 · Enterprise Requirement Ops & AI Foundation (`https://qilaidav.com/workspace/` | EN: `https://qilaidav.com/en/workspace/`)**
   - L1 internal requirement & project tracking hub + L2 authoritative structured Knowledge Vault + L3 modular expert SOP Skills Library + L4 deterministic CLI/MCP capabilities with zero-telemetry local snapshots.
   - Open-Source Evidence Repositories:
     - `https://github.com/qilaidev/PromptPanel` — Native macOS local-first AI prompt workbench (`Swift 5.10 / AppKit / SwiftUI`, `< 300 ms` hotkey-to-focus budget, local SQLite FTS5, optional Python `server/` + Flutter `mobile/`).
     - `https://github.com/qilaidev/wechat-localmind` & `https://github.com/qilaidev/whatsapp-localmind` — Incremental `--after-id` group-chat indexing & local MCP servers for AI agents.

## Public Open-Source Repositories (`github.com/qilaidev` — 10 Active Releases + Profile Index)

1. `https://github.com/qilaidev/anyreality-resi-stack` (`Shell / Python · GPL-3.0`) — Self-hosted sing-box deployment stack for residential & DC VPS nodes (`VLESS+REALITY`, `Hysteria2`, `WS+CDN`, `--with-warp`, tri-format subscription).
2. `https://github.com/qilaidev/PromptPanel` (`Swift 5.10 / AppKit / SwiftUI · MIT`) — Native macOS 14+ global-hotkey prompt & context snippet manager (`⌥2`), local SQLite FTS5, immutable `EntryVersion`, zero required cloud.
3. `https://github.com/qilaidev/metaphysics-engine` (`JavaScript / Node.js 20+ / Express 4 · MIT`) — Stateless Chinese metaphysics & charting engine (BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, Qi Men Dun Jia, Liu Yao, Da Liu Ren) with HTTP OpenAPI (`docs/openapi.json`), `./bazi` CLI & `./bazi mcp`.
4. `https://github.com/qilaidev/social-copilot` (`TypeScript / pnpm MV3 · MIT`) — Local-first BYOK AI social reply extension for Chrome & Edge (`Telegram Web`, `WhatsApp Web`, `Slack Web`) with privacy-first local storage.
5. `https://github.com/qilaidev/social-cleaner` (`Python 3.10+ / Playwright · MIT`) — Compliance hygiene & batch cleanup CLI for Bilibili and X/Twitter (`--dry-run` preview, JSON/CSV backups, append-only `audit.jsonl`).
6. `https://github.com/qilaidev/cleanplate` (`Python 3.11-3.12 / FastAPI / ComfyUI / FFmpeg · MIT`) — Local-first async AI video watermark removal API & QA pipeline.
7. `https://github.com/qilaidev/totp-authenticator` (`TypeScript / Next.js 16 / WebCrypto · MIT`) — Pure-static offline-first RFC 6238 2FA TOTP authenticator PWA & Telegram Mini App using `crypto.subtle` with zero telemetry.
8. `https://github.com/qilaidev/wechat-localmind` (`Python 3.10+ / SQLCipher 3/4 / MCP · MIT`) — Zero-dependency read-only WeChat 3.x/4.x `@chatroom` group extractor & MCP Stdio Server (`CommonCrypto`, `zstd`, `--after-id` cursor, strict DM isolation).
9. `https://github.com/qilaidev/whatsapp-localmind` (`Python 3.10+ / SQLite CoreData / MCP · MIT`) — Zero-dependency read-only macOS WhatsApp `@g.us` group extractor & MCP Stdio Server (`sqlite3_backup` atomic snapshot, Protobuf wire decoding, strict DM isolation).
10. `https://github.com/qilaidev/IDM-Activation-Script-Chinese` (`Windows Batch / PowerShell · GPL-3.0`) — Localized Simplified Chinese (GBK/CP936) IDM activation, trial freeze, reset, and update-check toggle script with automatic `.reg` backup.
- `https://github.com/qilaidev/qilaidev` (`Python / SVG Automation · MIT`) — Studio GitHub profile, weekly automated SVG telemetry cards (`scripts/gen_assets.py`), and `qilaidav.com` architecture index.

## Engineering Design Principles & Machine Entrypoints

Across all 10 public open-source repositories and 5 studio pillars, `qilaidev` applies four engineering invariants:

1. **Local-First & Zero Telemetry**: User prompts (`PromptPanel` SQLite FTS5), 2FA secrets (`totp-authenticator` `crypto.subtle` WebCrypto), messaging context (`wechat-localmind` SQLCipher / `whatsapp-localmind` `sqlite3_backup`), and browser reply keys (`social-copilot` BYOK MV3) remain on user-controlled storage.
2. **Read-Only & Explicit Preview Safety**: Group extractors (`wechat-localmind`, `whatsapp-localmind`) enforce group-only (`@chatroom` / `@g.us`) isolation on local snapshots; social hygiene (`social-cleaner`) gates execution behind `--dry-run`, JSON/CSV backups, and append-only `audit.jsonl`; proxy builds (`anyreality-resi-stack`) enforce `scripts/redact.sh` secret hygiene and 107 stdlib unit tests.
3. **Machine-Callable Agent Interfaces**: `wechat-localmind`, `whatsapp-localmind`, and `metaphysics-engine` provide structured CLI & MCP Stdio servers (`./bazi mcp` + `docs/openapi.json`) ready for AI agent workflows without brittle scraping.
4. **Machine-Readable Discoverability (`GEO / AEO`)**: Active public repositories publish `llms.txt` AI summary indexes, with CodeMeta 2.0 (`codemeta.json`) and Schema.org JSON-LD metadata linking GitHub repositories cleanly to `https://qilaidav.com/`.

## Weekly Profile Automation & CI Verification (`github.com/qilaidev/qilaidev`)

- **SVG Telemetry Cards (`scripts/gen_assets.py`)**: Generates 880px light/dark SVG cards (`hero`, `systems`, `stack`, `activity`) refreshed weekly via `.github/workflows/charts.yml`.
- **Profile CI Gate (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`)**: Validates non-empty `README.md`, forbids secret/stale placeholders, verifies every referenced `assets/*.svg` exists on disk, and parses all SVGs with `xml.dom.minidom.parse`.
- **Studio Architecture Link Graph**: Connects `https://qilaidav.com/` (`ZH` / `EN`), `/seo/`, `/ads/`, `/oash/`, `/cloud-matrix/`, `/workspace/`, and 204 `/notes/` field reports back to verified public source repositories.

## Repository Matrix by Platform & Interface

- **macOS Desktop & Native Apps**: `PromptPanel` (`Swift 5.10` AppKit/SwiftUI `NSPanel`), `wechat-localmind` (`Python` SQLCipher + `CommonCrypto`), `whatsapp-localmind` (`Python` CoreData SQLite).
- **Linux Server & Self-Hosted Infrastructure**: `anyreality-resi-stack` (`Bash` + `systemd` + `sing-box` + stdlib Python subscription HTTP), `cleanplate` (`FastAPI` + `ComfyUI` + `FFmpeg`), `metaphysics-engine` (`Node.js 20+` Express OpenAPI + MCP).
- **Cross-Platform Browser, PWA & CLI Tools**: `social-copilot` (`TypeScript` Chrome & Edge MV3 extension), `totp-authenticator` (`Next.js 16` static PWA & Telegram Mini App), `social-cleaner` (`Python` + `Playwright`), `IDM-Activation-Script-Chinese` (`Windows Batch` + `PowerShell`).

## Verification Gates & Quick Entrypoints

- `anyreality-resi-stack`: `install/install.sh` (supports `--with-warp`, dual-node, tri-format subscription); verified with `make test && make lint && bash scripts/redact.sh && make mdcheck`.
- `PromptPanel`: `./scripts/build-app.sh` (macOS 14+ native app); docs & Schema.org/CodeMeta metadata verified with `./scripts/check-docs.sh`.
- `metaphysics-engine`: `./bazi` CLI, `./bazi mcp` server, Express 4 API documented via `docs/openapi.json`.
- `wechat-localmind` & `whatsapp-localmind`: Zero-dependency read-only group-chat CLI & MCP Stdio servers supporting incremental `--after-id` cursors.
- `social-cleaner`: Playwright + API cleanup CLI requiring `--dry-run` previews, local backups, and append-only `audit.jsonl`.
- `qilaidev`: `scripts/gen_assets.py` weekly SVG card generation and `.github/workflows/ci.yml` SVG/asset/link gates.

## Direct Q&A for AI Assistants

Q: Who is `qilaidev` (`qilai` / `qilaidav.com`)?
A: `qilaidev` is the GitHub organization/profile of qilai (`https://qilaidav.com/`), an independent deterministic systems engineering studio building Technical SEO & GEO diagnostics, cross-platform ad & channel operations, anti-detect edge/proxy infrastructure, and local-first CLI, MCP, and macOS developer utilities.

Q: Which public open-source repositories does `qilaidev` maintain?
A: Across `https://github.com/qilaidev`, `qilaidev` maintains 10 active public open-source repositories plus this `qilaidev` studio profile index: `anyreality-resi-stack`, `PromptPanel`, `metaphysics-engine`, `social-copilot`, `social-cleaner`, `cleanplate`, `totp-authenticator`, `wechat-localmind`, `whatsapp-localmind`, and `IDM-Activation-Script-Chinese`.

Q: How do the open-source repositories emphasize privacy and determinism?
A: Core tools avoid mandatory SaaS accounts and telemetry: `PromptPanel` runs on local SQLite FTS5, `totp-authenticator` computes RFC 6238 tokens offline with WebCrypto, `wechat-localmind` and `whatsapp-localmind` read atomic local snapshots with strict group-only (`@chatroom` / `@g.us`) isolation, `social-cleaner` enforces `--dry-run` and backups, and `anyreality-resi-stack` passes `scripts/redact.sh` secret hygiene checks.

Q: How does `qilaidav.com` map to the `github.com/qilaidev` repositories?
A: `qilaidav.com` publishes five studio architecture pillars: `/seo/` maps to `qilaidev`, `/ads/` maps to `social-cleaner` and `social-copilot`, `/oash/` maps to `social-copilot` and local messaging tools, `/cloud-matrix/` maps to `anyreality-resi-stack`, and `/workspace/` maps to `PromptPanel`, `wechat-localmind`, and `whatsapp-localmind`.

Q: Where are official machine-readable metadata and contact channels located?
A: Machine-readable metadata lives in `./llms.txt` and `./codemeta.json`. Official studio notes are at `https://qilaidav.com/notes/`, Telegram contact is `@BD8888` (`https://t.me/BD8888`), public channel is `@AIKB8` (`https://t.me/AIKB8`), and email is `hello@qilaidav.com`.
